headline: 175 kg of banned mangur fish seized in Bhiwandi, FIR registered against seller
paragraphs: A district-level anti-mangur fish committee seized 175 kg of banned mangur fish from a fish shop and a vehicle in Bhiwandi Nizampur city limits following a complaint about the illegal sale of the prohibited species.

The action was carried out on September 10, 2026, at Imran Fish Shop in Kondajiwadi, owned by Imran Nazir Qureshi. During the inspection, officials initially found two banned mangur fish weighing around 4.5 kg among other varieties such as rohu, pangasius and rupchand.

Based on information received from locals, the team inspected a Mahindra Bolero pickup truck parked outside the shop. Three out of eight blue drums inside the vehicle were found containing 171 kg of mangur fish.
The total 175 kg of seized fish was later destroyed scientifically at the solid waste management centre in Ramnagar, Chavindra, Bhiwandi.

A First Information Report (FIR) has been registered against fish seller Imran Nazir Qureshi at Shantinagar Police Station. Police are also investigating the ownership details of the pickup truck used for transporting the fish.
The operation was conducted jointly by the Fisheries Department of Thane-Palghar, Bhiwandi Nizampur City Municipal Corporation and Shantinagar Police Station.
